def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}
    
    if not remediations:
        return []
    
    lines = ['   REMEDIATIONS']
    
    if is_using_api_key():
        for pkg_name, pkg_remediations in remediations.items():
            for version_spec, remediation in pkg_remediations.items():
                vuln_count = remediation.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
                recommended_version = remediation.get('recommended_version')
                other_versions = remediation.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                more_info_url = remediation.get('more_info_url', '')
                
                vuln_text = 'vulnerability' if vuln_count == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
                lines.append(f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {remediation.get("version")} was found, which has {vuln_count} {vuln_text}')
                lines.append(f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {recommended_version}')
                
                version_text = 'version' if len(other_versions) == 1 else 'versions'
                other_versions_str = ', '.join(str(v) for v in other_versions)
                lines.append(f'{" " * 78}')
                lines.append(f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}. Other {version_text}')
                lines.append(f'   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_versions_str}')
                lines.append(f'{" " * 78}')
                lines.append(f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit')
                lines.append(f'   {more_info_url}')
                lines.append(f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.')
                lines.append(f'{" " * 78}')
    else:
        total_vulns = sum(len(pkg_remediations) for pkg_remediations in remediations.values())
        total_pkgs = len(remediations)
        vuln_text = 'vulnerability' if total_vulns == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
        pkg_text = 'package' if total_pkgs == 1 else 'packages'
        lines.append(f'\n  {total_vulns} {vuln_text} was reported in {total_pkgs} {pkg_text}. For detailed remediation & fix ')
        lines.append(f'  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. ')
    
    lines.append('+==============================================================================+')
    
    return lines

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not styling:
        styling = {}
    
    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=columns,
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False
    )
    
    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)
    
    if max_lines and len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
    
    result_lines = []
    for i, line in enumerate(wrapped_lines):
        if i == 0:
            line = start_line_decorator + line + end_line_decorator
        else:
            line = start_line_decorator + line + end_line_decorator
        
        if color:
            line = click.style(line, fg=color, **styling)
        elif styling:
            line = click.style(line, **styling)
        
        result_lines.append(line)
    
    return '\n'.join(result_lines)

def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        packages = ctx.packages
        if not packages:
            no_locations = 'No locations found in the environment'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_locations}]], [no_locations]
        
        package_names = [pkg.name for pkg in packages]
        styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': name}] for name in package_names]
        return styled_items, package_names
    
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages
        if not packages:
            no_packages = 'No found packages in stdin'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_packages}]], [no_packages]
        
        package_names = [pkg.name for pkg in packages]
        styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': name}] for name in package_names]
        return styled_items, package_names
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file')
        if file_obj:
            file_path = file_obj.name
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_path}'}]], [file_path]
        return [[{'styled': False, 'value': 'No file found'}]], ['No file found']
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        if not files:
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': 'No files found'}]], ['No files found']
        
        styled_items = []
        file_paths = []
        for file_obj in files:
            file_path = file_obj.name
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_path}'}])
            file_paths.append(file_path)
        
        return styled_items, file_paths
    
    return [[{'styled': False, 'value': 'Unknown scanning target'}]], ['Unknown scanning target']

def build_report_brief_section(columns: Optional[int]=None,
    primary_announcement: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, report_type: int=1,
    **kwargs: Any) ->str:
    if columns is None:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns
    
    brief_info = get_report_brief_info(as_dict=False, report_type=report_type, **kwargs)
    
    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)
    
    styled_brief = ''
    for line_group in brief_info:
        for line in line_group:
            if line.get('style'):
                styled_brief += click.style(line.get('value', ''), bold=True)
            else:
                styled_brief += line.get('value', '')
        styled_brief += '\n'
    
    if primary_announcement:
        styled_brief += '\n' + build_primary_announcement(primary_announcement, columns=columns, only_text=False) + '\n'
    
    return styled_brief

def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    sentence = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using '}]
    
    if key:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': 'API Key'})
    elif account:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': f'account {account}'})
    else:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': 'default database'})
    
    if db:
        sentence.append({'style': False, 'value': f' from {db}'})
    
    sentence.append({'style': False, 'value': '.'})
    
    return sentence
